stem: Which sentence should replace sentence 30 to bring this letter to a more effective closing?

options.label: A
options.text: This has been a difficult letter for me to write, but I think that it’s important for you and your employees to know about my family.

options.label: B
options.text: I hope you will reconsider your store hours so that everyone in the area can continue to enjoy your delicious ice cream this winter.

options.label: C
options.text: Your ice cream is so delicious, and due to this fact, I don’t want to ever eat something stale from my freezer again.

options.label: D
options.text: I am absolutely certain that everyone in our local community agrees with everything I have written to you in this letter today.
